answer: Each submission hangs on the basalt of a task receipt, and the nadir is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The cedar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
